name: dsh-plugin
description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 原生 Bundle / Host Plugin 多插件 Monorepo

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dsh-code-worker/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dsh-suite-delta/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/plugin-template/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/dsh-suite-delta/tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @fongap-labs/dsh-desktop-delta exec tsc -b --pretty false
scripts.build: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dsh-code-worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dsh-suite-delta/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/plugin-template/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/dsh-suite-delta/tsconfig.client.json && pnpm --filter @fongap-labs/dsh-desktop-delta build
